167. One must not think that forms in matter generate other forms like themselves; for generating is a property of bodies. Rather, it is the right and duty of the **form** <note>The organizing principle or soul of a being.</note> to dispose the seminal matter for generation by harmoniously moving its own organs. It then encloses within that matter a ray of light, or a secret spark of life, like a treasure. It also imprints its own specific character upon that life-giving Spirit hidden in the seed. During the work of generation, through a pulsating heat and at the appointed time, this spirit unfolds into a **Soul**—whether vegetative <note>The level of soul responsible for growth and reproduction in plants.</note> or animal—so that what had been a secret and formal Spirit in the seed becomes the **Form** in the compound being. <summary>This page explains how biological reproduction preserves the immortality of a species through the transmission of "forms." It clarifies that while bodies perform the physical act of generation, the internal "form" organizes the matter and imprints a vital spark or soul into the seed.</summary>
<keywords>immortality of species, generation, seminal matter, life-giving spirit, vegetative soul, animal soul, formal spirit, Hermetic biology</keywords>
